slice: P2 source-bound AC1027 MLEADERSTYLE UTF-8 string edits
scope: The existing source-bound AC1027 MLEADERSTYLE transactions for group-3 description and group-300 textDefault now admit well-formed UTF-8 scalar text, including BMP and supplementary-plane characters, while refusing malformed UTF-8 and C0/C1 controls.

fieldEvidence.fieldRoleSource: Autodesk AutoCAD DXF Reference MLEADERSTYLE group-code table
fieldEvidence.encodingEvidence: Autodesk documents UTF-8 string storage for AutoCAD 2007 DXF and later, which includes AC1027.
fieldEvidence.selectedTextDomain: Well-formed UTF-8 scalar values without C0, DEL, or C1 control characters. AC1027 UTF-8 output only.
fieldEvidence.classification: Autodesk field-role evidence plus runtime-authored source-bound transaction, exact output and readback evidence. Not independent producer, legacy code-page, native rendering/meaning, or consumer semantic qualification.

contract.admission: Source and target must both be AC1027. The existing root-reachable MLEADERSTYLE baseline and unique physical string field must match. A replacement must be valid UTF-8 scalar text without C0, DEL, or C1 controls; the transaction may change only the selected group-3 or group-300 typed field.
contract.projection: Replace only the unique captured group-3 or group-300 STRING in the source-matched body. Preserve field order, opaque groups, other typed values and captured source identity. Missing/repeated fields, raw/typed conflict, mixed typed edits, unknown grammar and non-AC1027 routes remain outside this transaction.
contract.outputAndReadback: Runtime-authored ASCII and binary AC1027 inputs are written to ASCII and binary output. The focused selector checks exact raw STRING output and typed readback for group 3 and group 300, including BMP characters, an em dash and supplementary-plane characters. No DWG/DXF fixture file is committed.
contract.failureAndRetry: Conflicting raw/typed values, malformed UTF-8, LF, embedded NUL and U+0085 each refuse and preserve a sentinel destination. Restoring a valid request permits the same adapter instance to retry successfully. Existing checks also exercise unique source fields and cross-format readback.
contract.compatibility: Untouched records retain raw replay. Existing source- and target-AC1027 gating, one edited MLEADERSTYLE field per transaction and mixed-type refusal remain. This does not change DWG-origin writes, other versions or consumers.

sourceBindings.fixtureRecipe: generateRootMLeaderStyleControl in tests/dwg2dxf_adapter_tests.cpp creates source group 3 and group 300 at runtime; the focused test creates and removes its temporary input/output files.

focusedSelector.summary: 1/1 passed. Both string groups are exercised across ASCII/binary source and output, exact raw output and typed readback, malformed/control refusal, destination preservation and same-adapter retry.

limitations: The profile is limited to authored AC1027 DXF transactions for group 3 and group 300. It does not establish behavior for independent producers, other versions/code pages, Unicode normalization, MText rendering, native consumers, DWG editing or complete document closure.
The support ledger remains closed; no format support claim is promoted.
